about: Darpan's own choice of special pictures (13 Nov 2026). add: each choice gets its own special picture on its day, 'MM-DD' every year or 'YYYY-MM-DD' that day only. kind story (ref = the story's date or channel link), news (ref = the News article's path), year (year = that year's photos of the day), photos (photos = addresses, with year, place, headline, story). off: days with no special picture at all.
